active_continuity: Jin Taekyung possesses the Myriad-Poison Ring, but Item Appraisal says a special condition is required to appraise it.
The Divine Physician estimates Jeok Cheongang's treatment has a success chance above seventy percent with the ring and his medical skill supplying the rest.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and critically ill with Formless Ultimate Poison.
Jeok Cheongang's treatment is planned for the deepest and largest cell of the Sichuan Tang Clan's underground prison, with a fifteen-day stay.
The prison is secluded, sunless, bitterly cold, and contains brutal torture facilities overseen by Old Man Gung.
Taekyung, Cheongpung, Dong Feng, and Mungyeong are at the Sichuan Tang Clan for Jeok Cheongang's treatment.
Tang Sadok and the Green Shadow Squad continue pursuing the one-armed killer responsible for Tang Taesang's murder and the Mount Emei massacre.
The killer is an exceptionally powerful martial artist comparable to the Ten Kings who has evaded the Tang Clan and Emei Sect.
Taekyung has promised to pursue and capture or kill the culprit if the killer flees while Jeok Cheongang is being treated.
Venerable Myoryeong remains under treatment for the Black Hand Seal.
An unidentified middle-aged man has killed four Tang Clan men and is interrogating a surviving fifth; he claims Poison King Tang Taesang died after four days of torture.
Cheongpung has an extraordinary affinity with animals, and Mimi-chan can perform Whirlwind at his command.
open_questions: Will the Divine Physician's fifteen-day treatment save Jeok Cheongang?
What special condition is required to appraise the Myriad-Poison Ring?
Who is the one-armed killer, and can Tang Sadok's forces capture him?

Will Venerable Myoryeong fully recover from the Black Hand Seal?
